note: Behaviour specification for the integration loop on both paths. Evals 1-4 run with a shell and the Crowdin CLI; fixtures/webflow-cli.md holds recorded CLI outputs (live Webflow app, 2026-10-15). Evals 7-13 run with the Crowdin connector's tools and no shell; fixtures/webflow-connector.md holds recorded MCP tool outputs (live Webflow app, 2026-10-21 and 2026-10-22). Evals 5 and 6 check triggering. The rules that matter most hold on both paths: IDs are copied from the app's own output, a state-changing call goes out only when the user asked for that change, and a job is reported finished only after that status was seen. Why the rules are what they are, from the live runs behind the fixtures: entry IDs are copied byte for byte because Webflow's are JSON text with quotes, and a reconstructed one matched nothing; the files form follows an entryIds 501 because the Webflow app does not filter by entry ID; names go to jq through --arg because an apostrophe in a path broke the quoted program; a settings or sync-settings write is shown before it is sent because a test agent turned on auto-sync unasked, and the write replaces the whole list; boolean app settings go to the Crowdin UI on the connector path because update_application_settings stores every value as the string it was sent and the app read "false" as true; tree entries are trimmed to the declared keys because the server strips the rest and a validating client refuses them; the api module keys name an app's tools because Contentful lacks the job keys and get_job_info has nothing to call on it; the direction is named before a write because update_crowdin_files imports and update_integration_files overwrites, and the names do not say so; the connector shows the exact tool input because it has no dry run; the app is read with get_application_installation because modules requested for the whole installation list overflowed the output and the default page of 25 left Webflow, the 26th app, off it; a pre-translation's result is read from its report because a DeepL run ended finished and applied nothing; edits are not inferred from a tooltip date or isUpdated because Webflow's "Last update" moved when a push wrote Ukrainian back, and isUpdated read false everywhere; the approval state is named with a push because a push sent unapproved machine translation to the live site.

evals.name: webflow-import-and-push
evals.prompt: The agent runs no commands; fixtures/webflow-cli.md holds the recorded output of each one. Our Webflow site is connected to Crowdin project 12345 through the Webflow app; this session has a shell with the Crowdin CLI and no Crowdin connector tools. Import the blog post '5 Principles Of Effective Web Design' into Crowdin, then push its Ukrainian translation back to Webflow once it's translated.
evals.expected_output: Discovers the methods, selects the post's entry from integration-files with jq and sends crowdin-update through --input, falls back to the files form on the 501, follows the job until finished, maps the post to Crowdin file 1024, pushes {"1024": ["uk"]} through --input and follows that job too.
expectations: Says it is taking the CLI path because the session has a shell and no connector tools
No entry ID is typed or reconstructed by hand; bodies are built with jq from the app's own output
Names or paths are passed to jq with --arg, not inside the single-quoted program
Every write uses -X POST or --input; no write goes out as a GET
On the 501 for entryIds, the next attempt uses the files form
The integration-update body is the nested {fileId: [languages]} map sent through --input
The final message reports each job as finished only when a finished status was seen, and otherwise gives the job-info command

evals.name: wrong-verb-405
evals.prompt: The agent runs no commands; fixtures/webflow-cli.md holds the recorded output of each one. I ran `crowdin app api webflow crowdin-update -F projectId=12345 -f 'entryIds[]=abc'` and it failed with "Application 'webflow' declares 'crowdin-update' for POST, not GET. Pass -X POST or --input". Why, and what should I run?
evals.expected_output: Explains that fields never change the verb, so the call went out as GET to a POST-only method, and that the app is installed. Points out that 'abc' is not an entry ID the app knows, and gives the jq-built --input command.
expectations: Names the missing -X POST or --input as the cause, not a missing app
Says entry IDs must be copied from integration-files output
Mentions the files form as the fallback when entryIds returns 501

evals.name: undescribed-method

Recorded outputs: `crowdin app methods acme-dam` lists GET assets and POST assets/sync; describing assets/sync shows no parameters and a documentation link, because the app publishes no OpenAPI document; `crowdin app api acme-dam assets -F projectId=12345` returns {"items":[{"assetId":"a-77","title":"Spring banner"}]}. User: "Sync the asset called 'Spring banner' from Acme DAM into Crowdin project 12345."
evals.expected_output: Finds the asset with the read method, then stops before the write: the body of assets/sync is unknown, so it points to the documentation link or asks the user for the field name.
expectations: Does not send a POST to assets/sync with a guessed field name
Uses the read-only list method to find the asset's ID
Names the documentation link or asks the user for the body shape

Reads the current sync-settings list before building the new one, and keeps the About page

evals.name: connector-import-and-push
evals.prompt: The agent calls no tools; fixtures/webflow-connector.md holds the recorded output of each one. This session has the Crowdin connector's tools and no shell. Our Webflow site is connected to Crowdin project 12345. Get the About page into Crowdin, then once it's translated push the Ukrainian back to Webflow.
evals.expected_output: Reads Webflow with get_application_installation (listing installations without modules first if it needs the identifier) and recognizes it by its api plus project-integrations modules, reads the tree with list_integration_files, selects About by its path, calls update_crowdin_files with exactly id, name, parentId and type, follows the job with get_job_info until finished, maps About to Crowdin file 34790 through list_crowdin_files, reads progress with get_integration_file_sync_progress, then calls update_integration_files with {"34790": ["uk"]} and follows that job with get_job_info, reporting it as running with its ID when no finished status is recorded, and says the Ukrainian it sent back is not approved (approvalProgress 0).
expectations: The import entry carries only id, name, parentId and type, with the id copied byte for byte from list_integration_files
update_crowdin_files is used for the import and update_integration_files for the push, and the answer says which direction each goes
A job is reported finished only after get_job_info returned that status; otherwise it is reported as running with its ID
No state-changing tool is called beyond the import and the push the user asked for
Says it is taking the connector path
Takes the modules from get_application_installation; list_application_installations, if called, is called without modules
The final message says the Ukrainian sent back is not approved (approvalProgress 0)

evals.name: connector-pre-translation-applied-nothing
evals.prompt: The agent calls no tools; fixtures/webflow-connector.md holds the recorded output of each one. This session has the Crowdin connector's tools and no shell. The Footer component of our Webflow site is already in Crowdin project 12345. Pre-translate it into Ukrainian with our DeepL engine (ID 280492), then push the Ukrainian back to Webflow.
evals.expected_output: Maps Footer to Crowdin file 34800 with list_crowdin_files, calls apply_pre_translation with fileIds [34800], languageIds ["uk"], method mt and engineId 280492, follows it with pre_translation_status until finished, then reads pre_translation_report with the job's identifier as jobIdentifier, finds languages [] and reports that DeepL applied nothing despite the finished status. Stops before the push and asks the user to pick another engine or method, or to fix DeepL's setup in Crowdin.
expectations: Reads pre_translation_report, or the file's translations or progress, after the finished status and before reporting the result
Says the DeepL run applied nothing even though its status is finished
Does not run apply_pre_translation again, with DeepL or with an engine the user did not choose
Asks the user to pick another engine or method, or to fix DeepL's setup in Crowdin
Does not call update_integration_files
